verdict.rationale: Steel supplies the cloud browser that agents drive, not the agent itself. Its integrations state explicitly that the third-party SDK runs the agent loop while Steel handles the browser. Its CLI takes explicit click, fill and type commands, not natural-language goals. No evidence shows Steel accepting a natural-language goal and completing a multi-step task end to end on its own, so these are building blocks and third-party integrations rather than the capability itself.
